package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type TaskCapabilityInput struct {
	Type                   *string
	TaskKind               *string
	ExecutionMode          *string
	EvaluationMode         *string
	UIMode                 *string
	SubmissionMode         *string
	RequiresSandbox        *bool
	ExposesPreview         *bool
	ExposesTerminal        *bool
	SupportsLiveValidation *bool
}

type TaskCapabilities struct {
	Type                   int16
	ExecutionMode          int16
	EvaluationMode         int16
	UIMode                 int16
	SubmissionMode         int16
	RequiresSandbox        bool
	ExposesPreview         bool
	ExposesTerminal        bool
	SupportsLiveValidation bool
}

func InferTaskCapabilities(codeStructureTypeCode string, codeStructure json.RawMessage, in TaskCapabilityInput) (TaskCapabilities, error) {
	base := defaultTaskCapabilities(codeStructureTypeCode, codeStructure)
	if rawType := resolveTaskTypeInput(in); rawType != nil {
		taskType, err := ParseTaskType(*rawType)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
		base = defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(taskType)
	}
	return applyTaskCapabilityInput(base, in)
}

// ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability prevents task metadata from
// advertising php.core live feedback when its ValidationContractV1 exposes
// php.core only on Submit. Legacy contracts keep their existing validation
// path.
func ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(codeStructure json.RawMessage, supportsLiveValidation bool) error {
	if !supportsLiveValidation || len(codeStructure) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	var contract validationContractCapabilities
	if err := json.Unmarshal(codeStructure, &contract); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	if contract.Version <= 0 || contract.Kind == "" || len(contract.Stages) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	hasPHPCore := false
	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		if stage.Engine != "php.core" {
			continue
		}
		hasPHPCore = true
		if stage.Mode == "" || stage.Mode == ValidationStageModeBoth || stage.Mode == ValidationStageModeLive {
			return nil
		}
	}
	if !hasPHPCore {
		return nil
	}

	return fmt.Errorf("%w: supports_live_validation=true requires php.core in live or both mode", ErrValidation)
}

func MergeTaskCapabilities(current Task, in TaskCapabilityInput) (TaskCapabilities, error) {
	base := TaskCapabilities{
		Type:                   fallbackInt16(current.Type, TaskTypeFrontendPreview),
		ExecutionMode:          fallbackInt16(current.ExecutionMode, TaskExecutionModeBrowserPreview),
		EvaluationMode:         fallbackInt16(current.EvaluationMode, TaskEvaluationModeAuto),
		UIMode:                 fallbackInt16(current.UIMode, TaskUIModePreview),
		SubmissionMode:         fallbackInt16(current.SubmissionMode, TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot),
		RequiresSandbox:        current.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         current.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        current.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: current.SupportsLiveValidation,
	}
	if current.Type == 0 {
		base = defaultTaskCapabilities("", current.CodeStructure)
	}
	if rawType := resolveTaskTypeInput(in); rawType != nil {
		taskType, err := ParseTaskType(*rawType)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
		base = defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(taskType)
	}
	return applyTaskCapabilityInput(base, in)
}

func defaultTaskCapabilities(codeStructureTypeCode string, codeStructure json.RawMessage) TaskCapabilities {
	if inferred, ok := inferTaskCapabilitiesFromValidationContract(codeStructure); ok {
		return inferred
	}

	return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByCodeStructureType(codeStructureTypeCode)
}

func ApplyTaskCapabilities(task *Task, caps TaskCapabilities) {
	task.Type = caps.Type
	task.ExecutionMode = caps.ExecutionMode
	task.EvaluationMode = caps.EvaluationMode
	task.UIMode = caps.UIMode
	task.SubmissionMode = caps.SubmissionMode
	task.RequiresSandbox = caps.RequiresSandbox
	task.ExposesPreview = caps.ExposesPreview
	task.ExposesTerminal = caps.ExposesTerminal
	task.SupportsLiveValidation = caps.SupportsLiveValidation
}

func applyTaskCapabilityInput(base TaskCapabilities, in TaskCapabilityInput) (TaskCapabilities, error) {
	result := base
	var err error

	if in.ExecutionMode != nil {
		result.ExecutionMode, err = ParseTaskExecutionMode(*in.ExecutionMode)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
	}
	if in.EvaluationMode != nil {
		result.EvaluationMode, err = ParseTaskEvaluationMode(*in.EvaluationMode)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
	}
	if in.UIMode != nil {
		result.UIMode, err = ParseTaskUIMode(*in.UIMode)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
	}
	if in.SubmissionMode != nil {
		result.SubmissionMode, err = ParseTaskSubmissionMode(*in.SubmissionMode)
		if err != nil {
			return TaskCapabilities{}, err
		}
	}
	if in.RequiresSandbox != nil {
		result.RequiresSandbox = *in.RequiresSandbox
	}
	if in.ExposesPreview != nil {
		result.ExposesPreview = *in.ExposesPreview
	}
	if in.ExposesTerminal != nil {
		result.ExposesTerminal = *in.ExposesTerminal
	}
	if in.SupportsLiveValidation != nil {
		result.SupportsLiveValidation = *in.SupportsLiveValidation
	}
	if result.ExecutionMode == TaskExecutionModeNoRun {
		result.RequiresSandbox = false
		result.ExposesPreview = false
		result.ExposesTerminal = false
	}
	return result, nil
}

func defaultTaskCapabilitiesByCodeStructureType(codeStructureTypeCode string) TaskCapabilities {
	switch normalizeCodeStructureTypeCode(codeStructureTypeCode) {
	case "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT", "CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET", "REACT_COMPONENT_BASIC":
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeFrontendPreview)
	case "PHP_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeFullstackPage)
	case "NEXTJS_BASIC":
		caps := defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeFullstackPage)
		caps.EvaluationMode = TaskEvaluationModeManual
		caps.SupportsLiveValidation = false
		return caps
	case "EXPRESSJS_BASIC":
		caps := defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeAPIEndpoint)
		caps.EvaluationMode = TaskEvaluationModeHybrid
		return caps
	case "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC", "JAVASCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC", "TYPESCRIPT_BASIC_SCRIPT", "NODEJS_BASIC_SCRIPT", "JAVA_BASIC_SCRIPT", "KOTLIN_BASIC_SCRIPT":
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeCLIProgramming)
	case "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC":
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeQuizTheory)
	case CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic:
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeTest)
	case CodeStructureTypeTestOrderingBasic:
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeOrdering)
	case CodeStructureTypeTestClassificationBasic:
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeClassification)
	default:
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeFrontendPreview)
	}
}

type validationContractCapabilities struct {
	Version int                                   `json:"version"`
	Kind    string                                `json:"kind"`
	Stages  []validationContractStageCapabilities `json:"stages"`
}

type validationContractStageCapabilities struct {
	Engine string `json:"engine"`
	Mode   string `json:"mode"`
}

func inferTaskCapabilitiesFromValidationContract(codeStructure json.RawMessage) (TaskCapabilities, bool) {
	if len(codeStructure) == 0 {
		return TaskCapabilities{}, false
	}

	var contract validationContractCapabilities
	if err := json.Unmarshal(codeStructure, &contract); err != nil {
		return TaskCapabilities{}, false
	}

	if contract.Version <= 0 || contract.Kind == "" || len(contract.Stages) == 0 {
		return TaskCapabilities{}, false
	}

	hasFrontend := false
	hasBackendPage := false
	hasAPI := false
	hasCLI := false
	hasLiveStages := false

	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		if isFrontendEngine(stage.Engine) {
			hasFrontend = true
		}
		if isBackendPageEngine(stage.Engine) {
			hasBackendPage = true
		}
		if isAPIEngine(stage.Engine) {
			hasAPI = true
		}
		if isCLIEngine(stage.Engine) {
			hasCLI = true
		}

		if stage.Mode == "" || stage.Mode == ValidationStageModeBoth || stage.Mode == ValidationStageModeLive {
			hasLiveStages = true
		}
	}

	var taskType int16
	switch {
	case hasAPI && !hasFrontend && !hasBackendPage:
		taskType = TaskTypeAPIEndpoint
	case hasBackendPage || (hasFrontend && hasAPI):
		taskType = TaskTypeFullstackPage
	case hasCLI && !hasFrontend && !hasBackendPage && !hasAPI:
		taskType = TaskTypeCLIProgramming
	default:
		taskType = TaskTypeFrontendPreview
	}

	caps := defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(taskType)
	caps.SupportsLiveValidation = hasLiveStages && caps.RequiresSandbox
	return caps, true
}

const (
	ValidationStageModeLive  = "live"
	ValidationStageModeFinal = "final"
	ValidationStageModeBoth  = "both"
)

func isFrontendEngine(engine string) bool {
	switch engine {
	case "html.dom", "css.ast", "scss.ast", "react.ast", "browser.runtime":
		return true
	default:
		return strings.HasPrefix(engine, "nextjs.")
	}
}

func isBackendPageEngine(engine string) bool {
	switch engine {
	case "php.core":
		return true
	default:
		return strings.HasPrefix(engine, "php.") || strings.HasPrefix(engine, "nextjs.")
	}
}

func isAPIEngine(engine string) bool {
	switch engine {
	case "node.express", "node.fastify", "node.nest", "http.runtime":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isCLIEngine(engine string) bool {
	switch engine {
	case "js.ast", "ts.ast", "ts.runtime", "java.compile", "java.runtime", "kotlin.compile", "kotlin.runtime":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(taskType int16) TaskCapabilities {
	switch taskType {
	case TaskTypeFrontendPreview:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeFrontendPreview,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeAuto,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModePreview,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         true,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		}
	case TaskTypeFullstackPage:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeFullstackPage,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeManual,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModePreview,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         true,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	case TaskTypeCLIProgramming:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeCLIProgramming,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeAuto,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeTerminal,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		}
	case TaskTypeAPIEndpoint:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeAPIEndpoint,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeHTTPAPI,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeHybrid,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeReport,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		}
	case TaskTypeDebugFix:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeDebugFix,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeAuto,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeReport,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		}
	case TaskTypeRefactorQuality:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeRefactorQuality,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeHybrid,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeReport,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
		}
	case TaskTypeGitCLI:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeGitCLI,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeManual,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeTerminal,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	case TaskTypeSQLQuery:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeSQLQuery,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeTerminalRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeManual,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeTerminal,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	case TaskTypeQuizTheory:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypeQuizTheory,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeNoRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeAuto,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeQuiz,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeAnswerPayload,
			RequiresSandbox:        false,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	case TaskTypePracticeTaskMilestone:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   TaskTypePracticeTaskMilestone,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeBrowserPreview,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeManual,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModePreview,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeSnapshot,
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         true,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	case TaskTypeTest, TaskTypeOrdering, TaskTypeClassification:
		return TaskCapabilities{
			Type:                   taskType,
			ExecutionMode:          TaskExecutionModeNoRun,
			EvaluationMode:         TaskEvaluationModeAuto,
			UIMode:                 TaskUIModeQuiz,
			SubmissionMode:         TaskSubmissionModeAnswerPayload,
			RequiresSandbox:        false,
			ExposesPreview:         false,
			ExposesTerminal:        false,
			SupportsLiveValidation: false,
		}
	default:
		return defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(TaskTypeFrontendPreview)
	}
}

func resolveTaskTypeInput(in TaskCapabilityInput) *string {
	if in.Type != nil {
		return in.Type
	}
	return in.TaskKind
}

func normalizeCodeStructureTypeCode(raw string) string {
	return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
}

func fallbackInt16(value, fallback int16) int16 {
	if value == 0 {
		return fallback
	}
	return value
}
